mapper.select: SELECT psi.id, psi.location AS name, psi.real_status AS realStatus, coalesce(ai.lon, 0) AS lon, coalesce(ai.lat, 0) AS lat FROM parking_space_info psi LEFT JOIN station_info si ON psi.station_id = si.id LEFT JOIN area_info ai ON si.area_id = ai.id WHERE psi.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parking_space_info WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM parking_space_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND real_status = '空闲'
